articles.title: Bitcoin’s $224K ‘fair value’ may emerge if sovereign debt fears deepen: Bitwise
articles.snippet: A sovereign default-risk model estimates Bitcoin’s fair value at $224,000, as rising debt risks and bond-market stress could strengthen the asset’s long-term investment case.

articles.title: Bitmine buys $52M ETH as Tom Lee says price not yet showing Ethereum’s strength
articles.snippet: Bitmine is aiming to hold 5% of the total circulating supply of 120.6 million Ether tokens and is about 90% of the way to its target after its latest purchase.

articles.title: Trump’s Business Partner Teases Future Meme Coin Plans: 'We’re The Biggest Brand on Earth'
articles.snippet: Bill Zanker, a longtime Trump associate, will take the top 19 holders of the president’s meme coin to the World Cup Finals next month—and has plans for ongoing exclusive events.
